# lazybox

> A reactive PR inbox in your terminal: GitHub (and Linear) events flow to you as workspaces — a git worktree plus an embedded Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / shell session per task.

## Docs

- [Home](https://lazybox.ai/docs/): What lazybox is, who it's for, and a map of the documentation.
- [Tutorials](https://lazybox.ai/docs/tutorials/): Learning-oriented lessons for newcomers.
- [Quickstart](https://lazybox.ai/docs/tutorials/quickstart/): Install, open your first workspace, send a reusable workflow, and coordinate two sessions.
- [How-to guides](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/): Task-oriented recipes.
- [Add a repo](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/add-a-repo/): Bring a repository's PRs and issues into the inbox and filter by role.
- [Run an agent per workspace](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/run-an-agent-per-workspace/): Route task context, a running/default agent, model, and reasoning effort with `w w` or GitHub priority.
- [Trigger agents with @lazybox mentions](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/lazybox-mentions/): Choose priority and start an agent entirely from a GitHub issue.
- [Keep an issue session when its PR appears](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/keep-session-from-issue-to-pr/): Carry the live terminal, worktree, edits, and activity into the closing PR workspace.
- [Orchestrate multiple agents](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/orchestrate-multiple-agents/): Select workspaces across repos, compose once, and safely inject the instruction into every live agent or shell.
- [Use snippet workflows](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/use-snippets/): Send, repeat, create, scope, and broadcast workflows with recent-first and per-workspace memory.
- [Per-repo env and mounts](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/per-repo-env-and-mounts/): Inject env vars, symlink shared dirs, materialize scripts.
- [Remote over SSH](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/remote-over-ssh/): Run the daemon remotely and the TUI locally over a forwarded socket.
- [Mirror to Slack](https://lazybox.ai/docs/how-to/mirror-to-slack/): Reflect the inbox into Slack channels.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://lazybox.ai/docs/reference/cli/): Every lazybox subcommand, flag, and run mode.
- [Keybindings](https://lazybox.ai/docs/reference/keybindings/): The full keymap for every pane and picker.
- [Configuration](https://lazybox.ai/docs/reference/configuration/): The complete ~/.lazybox/config.yaml schema with an annotated example.

## Explanation

- [Mental model](https://lazybox.ai/docs/explanation/mental-model/): Workspace = worktree + agent, the reactive inbox, read/unread, and the isolation rationale.
- [Architecture](https://lazybox.ai/docs/explanation/architecture/): Client/daemon split, the crates, the event bus, the credential chain, and the embedded terminal.
